title: Fibonacci-partition power sums have algebraic growth exponents whose exponential scale tends to the square root of the golden ratio
difficulty: The argument constructs a synchronized product automaton for arbitrary integer moments and explicitly classifies its reachable states to obtain primitive Perron-Frobenius growth. It then controls the inaccessible spectral blocks and reduces arbitrary binary matrix products to two-dimensional factors with sharp spectral-norm bounds. These local constructions identify the generalized spectral radius, allowing a Kronecker-power limit theorem to determine the asymptotic moment exponent.

title: Three-uniform hypergraphs avoiding e edges on e+floor(log₂e)+38 vertices have a polynomial saving below quadratic size
difficulty: The proof designs eligible hypergraphs with independent good sets that preserve deficiency control under iterative gluing. A counted-copy dichotomy either produces many larger nondegenerate configurations or a sunflower whose core has controlled deficiency. Rainbow bipartite supersaturation starts the iteration, and a degree-one vertex removal argument achieves the exact requested edge count without losing the logarithmic deficiency bound.
